name: Catalyst Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Work with kids and families in the exhibit halls and run science activities. Build leadership and teamwork skills.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 17, per the center. The page says applications for the 2026-2027 school year have closed.
duration: Teams sign up for two week blocks, Monday to Friday
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 school year are closed. The page says to check back in the new year for the 2027 Summer Session.
how_to_apply: Complete the online application when it opens (it opens about twice a year, for Summer and School Year). Questions: volunteer@osc.org.
notes: The center says volunteering here meets most middle school and high school community service rules. Questions: volunteer@osc.org.
